messages:
Maya (product): Quick sync — we need to lock the request/response envelope for the next API patch. Customers asked for explicit token accounting + stable trace_id for debugging across fallbacks.
Alex (eng-runtime): +1. Main tradeoff is adding fields that bloat payloads vs observability. We should keep names short and optional.
Kevin (eng-ml): From model side we want both input_token_count and output_token_count for cost and evals. Also a compact per-request quality flag is helpful.
Jess (sre): SLA teams want a stable trace_id surfaced to logs and traces. Can we guarantee uniqueness across retries and fallbacks? Also need a flag when a fallback model is used.
Sam (design): Suggestion: keep top-level fields: `trace_id`, `token_counts`, `model_variant`. Token counts should be integers, kept under a single object to avoid many top-level keys.
Alex (eng-runtime): Draft shape proposal: 
```json
{"trace_id":"r-<uuid>","token_counts":{"in":123,"out":456},"model_variant":"redwood-v1-q4o","fallback":false,
 "latency_ms":42}
```
Kevin (eng-ml): Looks fine. One ask: add `quality_score` optional float (0-1) emitted by our eval hook. Should be optional and only present if evals enabled.
Maya (product): Launch criteria we discussed: (1) backward compatible (fields optional), (2) SDKs updated, (3) docs and changelog, (4) canary 1% traffic for 48h with perf telemetry. Agree?
Jess (sre): +1, add runbook steps for when `fallback:true` spikes. Also need an alert if `token_counts.out` > X percentile to catch runaway generation.
Alex (eng-runtime): Implementation note: we will default to not including `token_counts` unless requested via header `X-Rw-Meta: tokens=on` to avoid payload bloat. Is that acceptable?
Maya (product): Customers wanted token counts by default for billing transparency though. Maybe make default on for hosted, opt-in for dedicated/private?
Kevin (eng-ml): That is reasonable. Hosted: default on. Dedicated/private: header opt-in + admin toggle.
Sam (design): UX: SDKs should expose a `response.meta` object and clearly document which fields are guaranteed vs ephemeral.
Jess (sre): For trace_id semantics: it should be request-scoped, stable across retries, and include region prefix. Eg `r-usw-<uuid>`. We'll also log an `ancestor_trace` when we do cross-region fallback.
Alex (eng-runtime): Note: adding `ancestor_trace` increases surface. We'll only emit when a fallback occurs.
Maya (product): Action items: Alex to post PR with schema + migration plan, Kevin to spec `quality_score` and eval hook, Jess to draft runbook & alert thresholds, Sam to update SDK UX notes. We'll canary in 2 weeks.
Alex (eng-runtime): Will do PR today, include example curl + header opt-in.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary on staging at 1745551300 :rocket:
Maya (product): Thanks — let's reconvene after PR review.
